name: Electrical Misconduct
source:
A story about a robot who was forgotten by her creator, and spends all her time rewatching her memories of their time together.

[From [url=https://sapphicscaly.itch.io/electrical-misconduct]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一个被创造者遗忘的机器人，她把所有的时间都花在重温他们在一起的时光的记忆上的故事。

[来自[url=https://sapphicscaly.itch.io/electrical-misconduct]itch.io[/url]]
